text:
sara-cs: Hey finance — urgent escalation from Acme Logistics (acct acme-452). They say service suspended after dunning but claim PO# PO-99821 was submitted on 2026-03-02 and payment is in AP. Ticket CS-3241. Can someone confirm status?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-0315 issued 2026-03-15, status: unpaid. Dunning notice sent 2026-03-22. Service suspended per dunning policy 2026-03-23.

alex: Looking into it. I see a failed card attempt on 2026-03-20 (decline: issuer "insufficient_funds"). No successful charges recorded for INV-2026-0315.

jamal: Do we have the PO attached to the invoice metadata? Customer insists they sent it before suspension.

alex: DB snippet:
```
invoice_id: INV-2026-0315
po_number: PO-99821
po_attached: true
po_approved: false
payment_terms: NET45
tax_rate: 0.0
```
po_attached is true but po_approved is false — our billing workflow requires either approved PO or cleared payment to avoid suspension.

maria-am: I just spoke with Acme procurement. They forwarded proof that PO-99821 was created and emailed, but it went to billing@old-domain.com (legacy address) and didn't land in our AP inbox. They've just resent the signed PO and remittance instructions. Customer is requesting immediate restore and waiver of the late fee while AP processes payment.

finance-ops: We can do a provisional restore (limited capacity) while we validate docs. Waiving late fees is a supervisor decision — we can mark as "under review". Also note: invoice shows tax_rate 0.0; Acme is EU-based and expects VAT to be applied. Need to confirm tax handling before finalizing credit note.

kyle-se: Restoring full access to a suspended account without payment carries risk (excess usage). If we do provisional restore, put strict rate limits and rotate API keys.

sara-cs: Customer says production is down and they're pushing AP to release payment today. They'll accept limited throughput until payment clears. Can we do 48-hour provisional restore at a throttled level?

maria-am: I'm uploading the PO scan to the ticket and emailing finance with the remittance proof. If finance can toggle an approval flag we can avoid a formal collections step.

alex: For accounting we need either cleared payment or a signed AP agreement on file. I can flip a provisional flag in billing but it requires an ops audit entry. Proposal: provisional_restore = 48h at 10% capacity, set suspension_note = "provisional_restore: cs_escalation 48h", waive late fee pending payment confirmation.

finance-ops: Approved: provisional 48h limited restore. Waive late fee pending confirmation of remittance. Creating collections memo COL-2026-78 and documenting decision. Please attach the scanned PO and remittance confirmation to the invoice record.

sara-cs: Thanks — I'll notify the customer and confirm they see service. @maria-am please paste the PO scan link here when uploaded. :thumbsup:

maria-am: Uploaded PO scan to CS ticket and emailed finance (attachment: PO-99821_signed.pdf). CC @alex.

jamal: Once we have PO and remittance proof, I'll move invoice status to "pending payment (AP)" which stops further dunning. Alex, can you add the provisional note to the invoice?

alex: Done — invoice metadata updated and ops audit created (AUD-2026-412). provisional_restore flag set.

billing-bot: [automated] Update: service_reinstated (provisional) for account acme-452 until 1760700000. Dunning paused.

sara-cs: Customer confirms they're back online and running jobs. I'll keep this thread updated if AP clears payment.

maria-am: Follow-up: finance requested VAT documents. Acme sent VAT registration and I forwarded them. If VAT needs adjustment we'll issue a corrected invoice after payment.

finance-ops: Noted. We'll wait for remittance confirmation, then mark invoice paid and close COL-2026-78. If payment fails after provisional restore, collections resumes and suspension will be re-applied.

sara-cs: Good. Closing loop for now — thanks team."
